# SPRINTER MK.2-CLASS EXPEDITION SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Medium
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 2-4
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] AME
"A medium size expedition vessel with ample cargo space, a medbay, armoury and living space."
[italic]Originally designed by KesCo, refurbished for you by BlueBird Starship Design & Construction.[/italic]
# GETTING THE MOST OUT OF THE SPRINTER MK.2
- The cargo bay has plenty of space for you to add new machines, and there are spaces for additional machines in other rooms. - The crate racks in the engine nacelles are perfect for storing your hard earned loot! - Each engine nacelle houses a gyroscope behind a maintenance hatch.
